output.headline: Pays Hope Reimagined up to $10,000.30 to train four staff in nature-based stress reduction
output.summary: Hope Reimagined will give four district staff a three-day overnight training in forest bathing and nature connection, ending in a certification they can use with students during summer credit recovery and the school year. Trainers will also support Summer HAcK 2024 nature outings, through the OPSR Counseling Department. The period is May 15 to June 30, 2024, with a cap of $10,000.30. The agreement period began before the Board vote.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $2,000 for a contractor to organize parent and community events at Oakland High
output.summary: A contractor will help plan parent and community events such as Back to School Night and a family orientation, help families of feeder middle schools move to high school through the Incoming 9th Spring Invitational, and create materials about Oakland High School. The period is February 1 to May 23, 2024, with a cap of $2,000. The Board is ratifying an agreement whose period began before this vote.

output.headline: Ratifies $4,850 for Safari Encounters live-animal assembly at Global Family Elementary
output.summary: Safari Encounters will hold an assembly with live animals at Global Family Elementary School to teach students about animal adaptations, habitats and conservation, tied to the Adelante curriculum. The agreement covers April 18 to 19, 2024, with a cap of $4,850. The Board is ratifying an agreement whose period began before this vote.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $10,000 for Healing Aguas Wellness to train school counselors on student mental health
output.summary: Healing Aguas Wellness Solutions will give school counselors hands-on professional development on the mental health needs of their school communities, trauma-informed practices and small-group support strategies, through the OPSR Counseling Department. The period is January 1 to June 30, 2024, with a cap of $10,000. The Board is ratifying an agreement whose period began before this vote.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $6,000 for Soul Shoppe to coach staff launching a peacemaker program
output.summary: Soul Shoppe will provide monthly coaching for two adult staff so they can launch and run the Peacemaker Program at Oakland Academy of Knowledge. The period is April 15 to May 23, 2024, with a cap of $6,000. The Board is ratifying an agreement whose period began before this vote.

output.headline: Ratifies $500 for Red Tomatoes Org to provide fingerprinting for Sankofa school volunteers
output.summary: Red Tomatoes Org will provide Department of Justice live scan fingerprinting so Sankofa families can complete the volunteer process at Sankofa United Elementary School. The service was on March 26, 2024, with a cap of $500. The Board is ratifying an agreement whose period began before this vote.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $21,000 for Khepera Curriculum Group to train mentors at McClymonds High
output.summary: Khepera Curriculum Group will support initial professional development and training for instructors of the CAMP mentorship program, which pairs McClymonds High School and West Oakland Middle School scholars. It will also update the curriculum and evaluate both the high school and middle school parts of the program. The period is February 1 to June 30, 2024, with a cap of $21,000. The Board is ratifying an agreement whose period began before this vote.

output.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $31,500 to run summer intern stipends for Madison Park Academy
output.summary: The Oakland Public Education Fund will manage the stipend process for Madison Park Academy student interns in the summer ECCCO work-based learning program (Exploring College, Career, and Community Options). It will issue stipend payments, bill the district and issue tax documents, and keep 10% of processed stipends as its fee. The period is June 1 to June 30, 2024, with a cap of $31,500.

output.headline: Adds $30,000 to Elite Environment's water testing at child development centers, now up to $85,000
output.summary: This amendment adds $30,000 for water testing at the district's Child Development Centers, which is required to meet the state's child care licensing rules. The not-to-exceed amount rises from $55,000 to $85,000. The term stays July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024.

output.headline: Ratifies $5,400 for Sylint to research online threats tied to OUSD and nearby communities

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $5,400.00

output.summary: Sylint will use research tools to analyze social media and darknet sources for threats related to OUSD and neighboring communities, and report relevant findings to the district through the Risk Management Department. The period is May 1 to June 30, 2024, and the board is approving it after it began.

output.headline: Approves Personnel Report No. 2324-0009 from Talent/Human Resources
output.summary: The board approves the Talent/Human Resources Department's Personnel Report No. 2324-0009. The agenda text does not list the individual personnel actions or any dollar amounts; those are in the report itself.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $114,240 for Oakland REACH to run a summer literacy and math pilot at two sites
output.summary: The Oakland REACH will help run a summer school pilot at two sites, with literacy and math strategy, curriculum support, training for early literacy tutors, family outreach and data analysis. A data sharing agreement sets the rules for sharing student data with the group and protecting it. The period is May 1 to September 1, 2024, with a cap of $114,240. The Board is ratifying an agreement whose period began before this vote.

output.headline: Amends Oakland Promise data sharing agreement to add evaluation surveys, at no cost, through 2026
output.sourceIssueCandidate: The title says Data Sharing Agreement 2023-2024, but the text gives a term from January 28, 2021 through October 31, 2026.
output.summary: Oakland Promise will create survey and focus group questions to evaluate its Brilliant Baby, Kindergarten to College, College Access and College Completion programs. The district research and legal departments must review and approve the questions and parent permission forms. The agreement period runs January 28, 2021 to October 31, 2026 at no cost to the district.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $5,000 for Youth Uprising to host a summer credit recovery program
output.summary: Youth Uprising will host the Central Academic Recovery team's Summer Healing & Academics 4Kids credit recovery program, providing healthy snacks, classroom and auditorium space, and access to its recording studio, instruments, playground and social and mental health services. The period is May 29 to June 30, 2024, with a cap of $5,000. The Board is ratifying an agreement whose period began before this vote.

output.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $9,000 for an AmeriCorps member at Allendale Elementary
output.summary: Bay Area Community Resources will provide an AmeriCorps member to Allendale Elementary School as a Youth Support Specialist, giving small-group help to students that school staff identify as needing extra support. The period is January 16 to May 23, 2024, with a cap of $9,000. The agreement period began before the Board vote.

output.headline: Adds $300,000 to Leone Alberts & Duus legal services, for a 2023-24 total up to $850,000

money.evidence: in an additional amount of $300,000.00 for the 2023-24 fiscal year

output.summary: This amendment adds $300,000 for the law firm to keep providing hourly legal services, including civil litigation and legal advice as needed. The total cap for the 2023-24 fiscal year becomes $850,000. All other terms stay the same.

output.headline: Adopts the Board of Education minutes from the May 8, 2024 regular meeting
output.summary: The Board is adopting the written minutes of its regular meeting of May 8, 2024. Staff prepared the minutes shortly after the meeting.

output.headline: Ratifies two Board president appointments to the Measure G1 teacher retention oversight commission
output.summary: The Board is ratifying the Board president's appointments of two members, each in a first term effective May 23, 2024, to the Measure G1 Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act Oversight Commission. One term ends April 15, 2025 and the other April 15, 2026.

output.headline: Approves one-time payments and salary schedule changes for confidential and contract employees
output.summary: The Board is approving Resolution No. 2324-0073, which makes one-time off-schedule payments and a salary schedule adjustment for confidential employees and employees with employment contracts. The text does not state dollar amounts or dates.

output.headline: Approves the tentative labor agreement with the United Administrators of Oakland Schools through 2026
output.summary: The Board is approving a tentative agreement with the United Administrators of Oakland Schools, the district's administrators' union, for July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2026. The text says it comes with the disclosures required under state law (AB 1200). The text does not state a dollar amount.

output.headline: Approves $100,951,872.44 in district bill payments for March and April 2024
output.summary: The board approves 3,258 accounts payable checks printed from March 1 through April 30, 2024, totaling $100,951,872.44. That is 1,280 checks totaling $40,786,767.77 in March and 1,978 checks totaling $60,165,104.67 in April. The full lists are in the attached exhibits.

output.headline: Approves $51,522,962.60 in payroll payments for March and April 2024
output.summary: The board approves payroll payments made from March 1 through April 30, 2024: 1,853 payroll checks printed and 17,986 direct deposits, totaling $51,522,962.60. The detail is in the attached exhibit.
